New raw `raw/stripe-products-prices-pricing-models-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-recurring-pricing-models-2026.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-recurring-pricing-models.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/products-prices/pricing-models`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/products-prices/pricing-models, old raw lines 6-21 and new raw lines 7-22 describe businesses combining Products to represent what they sell with Prices to define amount, currency and recurring period. Customers can choose a flat-rate service tier, buy per-user or license units, or be billed with tiered or usage-based prices. Usage-based options include fixed fee with overage, pay as you go and credit burndown. Both captures offer design patterns without specifying API setup, eligibility or state transitions. The tiered row pairs volume with quantity and graduated with usage in both dates. The linked tiered guides clarify that tiers can apply to quantity or usage. Volume uses one selected rate for all units, while graduated pricing sums the charges across tiers. The existing source-stripe-recurring-pricing-models.md covers all four patterns but repeats the shorthand at line 21, which warrants clarification.
reviewed_answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/products-prices/pricing-models, old raw lines 6-21 and new raw lines 7-22 retain the same model descriptions. The abbreviated table delimiter is formatting. Only the usage-based link moves from May's subscriptions pricing guide to November's Billing usage-based overview, whose captured Metronome and migration routes do not establish a universal prerequisite, migration obligation or retirement of the older guide. Retain both dated raw versions and the former URL as evidence. The source-stripe-recurring-pricing-models.md requires a separate baseline correction to line 21: both dated tiered guides recognize quantity or usage, with volume charging all units at one tier's rate and graduated summing charges across the tiers used. Preserve the provider index and reciprocal wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions.md and its tier calculation entry, along with the link to the adjacent integration design source, whose line 25 already distinguishes the calculations.
